 MP Board Dummy admit card 2027 out for classes 10, 12; check details and correction deadline
 The dummy admit card allows students and schools to identify errors in examination records and correct them before the main examinations.
 Curated by Mansi 
 Image: Canva 
 Nov 08, 2026
 Share
 The Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (MPBSE) has released dummy admit cards for students appearing in the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027. Students can access their provisional hall tickets through the official website, mpbse.mponline.gov.in. 
 The board has asked school principals to verify the details mentioned on the dummy admit cards and arrange corrections wherever necessary. Students must also check their personal and examination details before the board issues the final admit cards. 
 The dummy admit card allows students and schools to identify errors in examination records and correct them before the main examinations. Any changes to subjects, examination medium or other details can be made online after paying the prescribed correction fee. 
 MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027: Details to check 
 Student's name: Check the spelling and ensure that it matches the school records. 
 Parents' names: Verify the spelling of both parents' names. 
 Date of birth: Check whether the date matches the official records. 
 Subjects: Ensure that all registered subjects, including additional subjects, appear correctly. 
 Examination medium: Verify the language or medium selected for the examination. 
 Photograph and personal details: Check the photograph and other information printed on the admit card. 
 MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027: How to make corrections 
 Students who find errors in their dummy admit cards must inform their school principal or examination in-charge immediately. They cannot make changes independently through the online portal. 
 School authorities will have to log in to the designated portal, initiate the correction process and update the details according to the board's prescribed procedure. The board may charge a fee depending on the type of correction. 
 The online declaration form submission process began on October 26, 2026. School principals and forwarding institution principals must complete the verification and correction process and submit the declaration form online by December 31, 2026. 
 When will MP Board release the original admit cards? 
 MPBSE has clarified that students can download their original admit cards for the 2027 Class 10 and Class 12 examinations only after their respective schools submit the online declaration form. 
 Students should coordinate with their school authorities to ensure that they have checked all details and reported any discrepancies before the December 31 deadline.
